newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen ease on jobs data, technical factors.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen ease on jobs data, technical factors.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures were slightly easier late on Friday following an improvement in Japan's March unemployment rate, but dealers said trade was largely technically driven amid a lack of fresh leads.
December Euroyen stood at 99.00 at 1110 GMT against its IMM close at 99.02 after trading in a 98.99-99.05 range.
Japan's seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate fell to 3.2 percent in March, down from 3.3 percent in February and at its lowest level in 12 months.
"Every time some large-lot selling came in, there was no real buying to support the market," a trader with an Asian institution said.
Japanese government bond futures for June settled at 125.46 against their previous 125.38. Support is seen at 125.35 and 125.10.
The trader said players were careful about taking aggressive positions ahead of the U.S. non-farm payrolls report for April at 1230 GMT.

"The forecasts have been very wide -- anywhere between 150,000 and 250,000. The last few (U.S.) numbers have been very mixed but some of them suggest the economy might slow down in the second half," the trader said.
Eurodollar futures ended scarcely changed against their IMM close with December at 93.655 on volume of 5,000 lots.
